Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BS at University of Notre Dame

What University of Notre Dame asks of applicants to Computer Science BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All University of Notre Dame courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-optional for fall 2027 entry (2026–27 cycle) — first-year and transfer applicants
  • ACT or SAT will be required from the 2027–28 cycle (fall 2028 entry)
  • Students studying outside the US who complete the IB Diploma, A-Levels (3+) or French Baccalaureate may submit predicted results in lieu of SAT/ACT
Verified19 Oct 2026Notre Dame: Standardized Testing Policy · Notre Dame: Application Overview
English language
  • English proficiency test required if first language is not English or secondary education was not primarily in English
  • Accepted tests: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test, PTE Academic
  • Strongly recommended scores:
    • TOEFL iBT 100 (Speaking 25) on the pre-February 2026 scale, or 5.5 average (no section below 5.0) on the updated scale
    • IELTS 7.5
    • Duolingo 125
  • Waived with SAT EBRW 650+ or ACT English or Reading 26+

Notre Dame introduces these scores with “We strongly recommend the following scores”, though the table column is headed “Required Score”; shown as strongly recommended, not as a hard minimum. No PTE score is listed.

Verified19 Oct 2026Notre Dame: International Applicants — Application Information
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Verified19 Oct 2026Notre Dame: Application Overview
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: required for all applicants — at least 16 high-school units, including 4 English, 3 mathematics, 2 of one foreign language, 2 science, 2 history/social science. For intended majors in the College of Engineering (where Computer Science sits): 4 units of mathematics required, including Pre-Calculus or Calculus; a unit of Chemistry required; and a unit of Physics required for all Engineering majors.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Notre Dame: FAQs
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
British-curriculum students are asked to submit GCSE/IGCSE results and predicted A-Levels; typical applicants are enrolled in at least three A-Level subjects. Students studying outside the US may submit predicted A-Level results (3+) in lieu of SAT/ACT.
Verified19 Oct 2026Notre Dame: International Applicants — Application Information · Notre Dame: Standardized Testing Policy

Other qualifications
  • AP exam scores (and IB exam scores) may be self-reported on the application or the applicant status portal — optional

Other requirements
  • Notre Dame Writing Supplement required (one short essay and two short answers)
  • No interviews; optional Glimpse video (U.S. high schools) or InitialView (international high schools)
